content.value: Determine horse power required to drive a centrifugal pump which delivers 36 liters of 15 water per second to a height of 20m through a l 30mm diameter and I 05m long pipeline. The overall efficiency of the pump is 70% and Darcy's, f = 0.03 for pipeline. Assume inlet losses in suction pipe is equal to 0.45m.
